name: kv-upstash

envVars.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL: REST endpoint of your Upstash Redis database, the `https://<name>-<id>.upstash.io` one from the database page under REST API. Required once KV_PROVIDER=upstash. Read from apps/api/.dev.vars in local dev and from a Workers secret (`wrangler secret put UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL`) in production. There is no default: unset, every call through this provider throws KvError("provider_error") before a request leaves the Worker.
envVars.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN: REST token for the same database, from the same panel. Use the read-write token — the read-only one cannot `SET`, `DEL` or run the limiter's `EVAL`. Store it as a Workers secret (`wrangler secret put UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN`), never in wrangler.jsonc, and rotate it in the Upstash console if it leaks. A wrong token surfaces as KvError("provider_error") with providerCode `401` and retryable false, because retrying a bad credential only burns request budget.

removeWarnings: Removing this module does not delete the Upstash database or the keys in it. Delete the database in the Upstash console when nothing else reads it, and revoke UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN.
`@upstash/redis` stays in packages/kv/package.json. Uninstalling an npm dependency is yours to do; run `pnpm remove` in that workspace when nothing else needs it.
